classes.name: Instance
classes.doc: The root of the class tree. Every object scripts reach through the data model is an Instance: an entity with a ClassMarker. Its members are declared by the data model work package (classes/instance.json).

classes.name: ServiceProvider
classes.doc: An instance that owns services and finds them by class name.

classes.name: DataModel
classes.doc: The root of a place, reached as the global `game`. In a scene it is the root entity with id "game"; services are its children.

classes.name: PVInstance
classes.doc: An instance with a position and orientation in the world, directly or through its parts.

classes.name: Model
classes.doc: Groups parts and other instances into one object that can be moved, cloned and named as a unit.

classes.name: Folder
classes.doc: A plain container for organising instances. It has no behaviour of its own.

classes.name: Configuration
classes.doc: A container for value objects that tune a model or tool, by convention.

classes.name: LuaSourceContainer
classes.doc: An instance that holds Luau source. The source itself lives in a file under scripts/, named by the entity's ScriptRef.

classes.name: BaseScript
classes.doc: A script that starts on its own when the place runs, in the context its class and run context choose.

properties.name: RunContext
properties.doc: Where the script runs. Legacy follows the class and the script's place in the tree; Server and Client run it in that context wherever it is.

classes.name: Script
classes.doc: A script that runs in the server context (or the client context when its run context is Client). Its ScriptRef has context "server" or "client".

classes.name: LocalScript
classes.doc: A script that runs in the client context for the local player. Its ScriptRef has context "client".

classes.name: ModuleScript
classes.doc: A module: it runs only when a script requires it, once per context, and its result is cached. Its ScriptRef has context "module".
